_about: Where the product lives and how to film it, for the capture tool (tools/capture/README.md). How to fill it in: brands/_template/product/README.md. Keys that start with _ are notes for people.
_kind: The kind of product, which fills sensible defaults for it: "web app", "ai product", "wordpress", "shop", "extension", "phone web", "desktop" (an Electron app, with "app"), "phone app" (with "phone"), "command line" (with "terminal"). What each sets: node tools/capture/capture.mjs kinds. Anything written below wins.
_browser: Which Chrome records by default: "mine" (your own Chrome, through the Playwright Extension) or "studio" (the studio's own window). Empty: the studio's default (your own Chrome; check uses the studio's window).

_optional._about: Copy any of these up a level when the product needs it (brands/_template/product/README.md says what each does).

site._note: WordPress: put a WordPress Playground blueprint in blueprint.json next to this file and the studio builds a fresh demo site for every take; or "site": "own" to film the address above, signed in by hand
